text:
alex: heads-up — we're seeing JIT role assignment failures after the tenant policy change rolled yesterday. two customers in staging and one prod report: roles not applied when multiple role_claims are present.

tara: which policy change exactly? the tenant-scoped role quorum logic?

josh: yes, PR 5192 introduced a "quorum" check for role_claims scoped by tenant. it was meant to require at least N matching claims but appears to treat comma-separated claims as a single string value.

maria: repro steps from customer: they send SAML assertion with Role attribute like: 
```xml
<Attribute Name="https://okta.example.com/claims/roles">
  <AttributeValue>team:editor,team:viewer</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
```
Customer expects two roles; runtime treats as one literal claim and fails the quorum.

josh: reproducer in staging: parsing path uses .lower().split() instead of splitting on commas and trimming. so "team:editor,team:viewer" stays one token.

alex: thats consistent with logs: 
```
2026-03-20T14:12:01Z authd[pid=2123] INFO claim_check tenant=acme user=bob claim="team:editor,team:viewer" matched=false
```

tara: oof. is this limited to Okta/SAML or affects SCIM/other attribute formats too?

maria: initial scope is SAML/Okta because attribute arrives as single AttributeValue string. SCIM sends arrays and unaffected.

security-bot: created INC-2026-43: "JIT role assignment rejects multi-valued role_claim as single token" assigned to eng-security.

oncall-kyle: mitigation idea: relax quorum to try splitting by common delimiters for a hotfix and set circuit-breaker to non-strict mode for affected tenants.

josh: quick patch sketched: 
```py
# naive fix
raw = attr_value
roles = [r.strip() for r in re.split('[,;\n]+', raw) if r.strip()]
for r in roles:
    check_role_quorum(r)
```
this will address comma/semicolon/newline.

pm-sarah: any audit impact? customers will want proof who got assigned what and when. we should ensure audit logs capture the original assertion and the normalized list we applied.

alex: agreed. current logging only stores the matched claim string; we need to add normalized_roles list to audit_event and to the tenant audit export.

maria: note on KMS: one customer uses encrypted SAML assertions with attribute-level encryption. KMS decrypt path goes through our attribute parser; need to ensure decrypt happens before normalization. otherwise splitting fails because value is still ciphertext.

josh: good catch — decrypt step happens in inbound pipeline earlier, but our unit tests missed encrypted attribute scenario. will add test.

tara: plan: 1) hotfix parser in staging and run smoke against two affected customers (1h). 2) add normalization + audit fields (2h). 3) add unit tests for encrypted attributes and SCIM parity (2h). 4) patch prod in canary then full (slo window 4h).

alex: prioritize canary for Dedicated customers first (they reported prod). enable fallback mode (non-strict quorum) while patching so ongoing requests succeed.

oncall-kyle: implementing fallback toggle now in feature-flags service. pushing flag for tenant acme and tenant-beta.

josh: deploying patch to staging now, will post results.

maria: created a short playbook note to include in incident ticket describing audit retention needs and KMS decrypt ordering.

security-bot: update INC-2026-43 status: in_progress by josh.

josh: staging smoke passed for acme & tenant-beta. normalized_roles logged as: ["team:editor","team:viewer"]. no regression in SCIM. added unit test for encrypted attribute decryption order.

pm-sarah: please capture a sample audit export for legal review once in prod.

alex: after prod canary and 30m monitoring clean, we'll flip the strict quorum back on with fixed parser.

josh: canary started for dedicated cluster dc-3. monitoring hooks: role_assignment_failures, auth_latency, audit_event_size.

maria: leaving a note: postmortem should include: why attribute format contract wasn't documented, missing unit tests for encrypted attr, and decision to add normalized_role field to audit schema.

oncall-kyle: prod canary green at +25m. rolling to full prod.

security-bot: INC-2026-43 resolved by 2912345789. changelist: PR 5237.

alex: thanks all. follow-ups: add doc to SSO onboarding about accepted attribute formats, add an integration test for Okta JIT flows, and notify the two affected customers with timeline and audit export.

pm-sarah: I'll draft customer notifications and attach audit export once available. :email:
